title: If I had served my God as I have served my king He would not have abandoned me in my old days
html_source:
In Shakespeare’s Henry VIII, Act III, Scene 2, Wolsey laments to Cromwell:

… O Cromwell, Cromwell!
Had I but served my God with half the zeal
I served my king, he would not in mine age
Have left me naked to mine enemies.

anchor.text: If I had served my God as I have served my king He would not have abandoned me in my old days
